name: Tea Tree & Salicylic Acid Acne Control Face Wash
tagline: Fights active acne and controls excess sebum without drying your skin.
description: Formulated with pure Tea Tree Oil and 2% Salicylic Acid (BHA), this gentle foaming face wash penetrates deep into pores to clear out dirt, oil, and acne-causing bacteria. Packed with Aloe Vera extracts to soothe redness and irritation.
ingredients: Aqua, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Salicylic Acid (2%), Tea Tree Essential Oil, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Allantoin, Phenoxyethanol.
howToUse: Squeeze a small amount onto wet palms. Gently massage onto face in circular motions for 30 seconds. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry. Use twice daily.

name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Spot Correcting Serum
tagline: Fades dark spots, reduces blemishes, and refines uneven skin texture.
description: A high-strength vitamin and mineral blemish formula that targets hyperpigmentation, acne marks, and enlarged pores. Niacinamide strengthens the skin barrier, while Zinc PCA regulates sebum production.
ingredients: Aqua, Niacinamide (10%), Zinc PCA (1%), Hyaluronic Acid, Aloe Vera Extract, Xanthan Gum, Ethylhexylglycerin.
howToUse: Apply 2-3 drops onto clean, dry skin. Gently pat into the skin until fully absorbed. Follow with moisturizer. Suitable for AM and PM use.

name: Centella Asiatica (Cica) Calming Gel Moisturizer
tagline: Instant soothing gel that repairs skin barrier and reduces redness.
description: An ultra-light, non-sticky gel cream enriched with 70% Centella Asiatica Extract and Ceramide NP. It instantly cools irritated skin, locks in hydration, and restores the skin barrier damaged by pollution or harsh exfoliants.
ingredients: Centella Asiatica Leaf Water (70%), Glycerin, Ceramide NP, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Carbomer, Arginine, Centella Extract.
howToUse: Apply an adequate amount to cleansed face and neck. Gently press in until absorbed. Use daily, morning and night.

name: Alpha Arbutin 2% Pigmentation Cream
tagline: Advanced formula to diminish hyperpigmentation and reveal glowing skin.
description: An advanced skin brightening cream containing 2% Alpha Arbutin and Kojic Acid. Effectively reduces melanin synthesis, lightens age spots, sun damage, and melasma, giving you an even-toned complexion.
ingredients: Aqua, Alpha Arbutin (2%), Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Kojic Acid Dipalmitate, Cetearyl Alcohol, Niacinamide, Vitamin E, Disodium EDTA.
howToUse: Apply a pea-sized amount to affected areas or full face at night after serums. Always follow up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen the next morning.

name: Hyaluronic Acid 2% Hydrating Serum
tagline: Multi-molecular weight serum for deep, multi-layer hydration.
description: A hydration support formula featuring multi-molecular Hyaluronic Acid alongside Vitamin B5. It attracts moisture from the air and seals it deep into the skin layers to plump up fine lines and cure dryness.
ingredients: Aqua, Sodium Hyaluronate, Panthenol (Vitamin B5), Pentylene Glycol, Glycerin, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Polyacrylate.
howToUse: Apply 3-4 drops to slightly damp face and neck. Gently massage and seal immediately with a nourishing moisturizer.

name: Green Tea & AHA Pore Tightening Toner
tagline: Gently exfoliates dead skin cells, minimizes pores, and balances pH.
description: An alcohol-free, refreshing toner packed with Green Tea extracts and Glycolic Acid (AHA). It unclogs pores, swipes away dead skin build-up, balances skin pH, and preps your skin for subsequent treatment steps.
ingredients: Green Tea Extract, Glycolic Acid (AHA 1.5%), Allantoin, Witch Hazel Extract, Tea Tree Oil, Salicylic Acid, Aqua.
howToUse: Pour a few drops onto a cotton pad or your clean palms. Swipe or pat gently across cleansed face and neck. Avoid eye contour. Use in PM.

name: Retinol 0.5% Wrinkle Correcting Night Cream
tagline: Accelerates cell turnover to reduce wrinkles, fine lines, and age spots.
description: Formulated with stabilized 0.5% Retinol, Peptides, and Coenzyme Q10. This overnight treatment speeds up cell renewal, stimulates collagen synthesis, and fights signs of aging while nourishing skin with Shea Butter.
ingredients: Aqua, Retinol (0.5%), Shea Butter, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Coenzyme Q10, Jojoba Oil, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Phenoxyethanol.
howToUse: Start by using 2-3 times a week at night only. Apply a small pea-sized amount to face after serums. Don't mix with Vitamin C or AHAs.

name: SPF 50+ PA++++ Ultra Light Matte Sunscreen
tagline: Broad-spectrum UV protection with zero white cast and a matte finish.
description: A hybrid gel-based sunscreen that provides high broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays. Infused with Hyaluronic Acid and Ceramide to hydrate skin without leaving any white cast, greasiness, or oiliness.
ingredients: Octyl Methoxycinnamate, Zinc Oxide, Titanium Dioxide, Ceramide NP, Hyaluronic Acid, Cyclopentasiloxane, Glycerin, Aqua.
howToUse: Apply generously on face, neck, and exposed skin 15 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every 2-3 hours for continuous protection.

name: Vitamin C 15% Glow Serum
tagline: Powerful antioxidant serum for glowing, radiant, and youthful skin.
description: Made with 15% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (a highly stable Vitamin C derivative) and Ferulic Acid. It protects against sun damage, neutralizes free radicals, boosts collagen, and dramatically brightens dull complexions.
ingredients: Aqua, Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (15%), Ferulic Acid (0.5%), Vitamin E, Hyaluronic Acid, Orange Peel Extract, Phenoxyethanol.
howToUse: Apply 3-4 drops in the morning on clean face. Pat gently. Lock with moisturizer and follow up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen.

name: Clay Mask with Activated Charcoal & Kaolin
tagline: Draws out toxins, blackheads, and impurities from deep within.
description: Enriched with Kaolin Clay, Bentonite, and Activated Charcoal. This deep cleansing mask acts like a magnet to pull out blackheads, excess sebum, and environmental impurities, leaving pores visibly smaller and skin refreshed.
ingredients: Kaolin Clay, Bentonite Clay, Activated Charcoal Powder, Glycerin, Witch Hazel Extract, Phenoxyethanol, Glycolic Acid, Aqua.
howToUse: Apply an even layer over face, avoiding eyes and mouth. Let dry for 10-15 minutes. Rinse off gently with lukewarm water. Use 1-2 times a week.
